name_zh: 黑格尔/德国/辩证法/绝对精神/历史哲学/普鲁士国家
description_zh: 格奥尔格·威廉·弗里德里希·黑格尔 (1770-1831) 德国古典哲学集大成者，辩证法三段论（正-反-合）奠定现代哲学基础，绝对精神自我展开构建历史哲学体系，普鲁士国家作为理性实现的最高形式，影响马克思/海德格尔/哈贝马斯百年传承。
description_en: Georg Wilhelm Friedrich Hegel (1770-1831) German classical philosophy culminator, dialectical triad (thesis-antithesis-synthesis) founded modern philosophy basis, absolute spirit self-unfolding constructed philosophy of history system, Prussian state as highest form of reason realization, influenced Marx/Heidegger/Habermas century-long inheritance.
reason_zh: 黑格尔代表哲学如何通过辩证法将历史纳入理性体系，展示了国家作为伦理实体如何超越个人主观性，其辩证法成为马克思历史唯物主义与西方现代哲学的共同母体。
reason_en: Hegel represents how philosophy incorporates history into rational system through dialectic, demonstrating how state as ethical entity transcends individual subjectivity, his dialectic becoming common matrix for Marx historical materialism and Western modern philosophy.
steps_zh: 研究黑格尔早年图宾根/耶拿/海德堡教授生涯
分析《精神现象学》主奴辩证与绝对知识
探讨《法哲学原理》国家伦理与公民社会
评估黑格尔左派/右派分化与马克思继承
总结辩证法/绝对精神/国家理性三重哲学遗产
steps_en: Analyze Phenomenology of Spirit master-slave dialectic and absolute knowledge
Explore Philosophy of Right state ethics and civil society
Evaluate Hegelian Left/Right split and Marx inheritance
Summarize dialectic/absolute spirit/state reason triple philosophical legacy
expected_zh: 掌握辩证三段论如何将历史纳入理性必然性，理解国家作为客观精神的伦理实体地位，评估黑格尔哲学对马克思主义/存在主义/批判理论的决定性奠基。
expected_en: Master how dialectical triad incorporates history into rational necessity, grasp state as objective spirit ethical entity status, evaluate Hegel philosophy decisive foundation for Marxism/existentialism/critical theory.
case_zh: 1807 精神现象学；1821 法哲学原理；1831 霍乱逝世。辩证法/绝对精神/国家理性范式永存。
case_en: 1807 Phenomenology; 1821 Philosophy of Right; 1831 cholera death. Dialectic/absolute spirit/state reason paradigm endures.
intellectual_tradition: German Idealism / Dialectics / Philosophy of History
cross_cultural_impact: Dialectic; absolute spirit; philosophy of history; Marxism; critical theory
